Market today: The mood is mixed for tech. Strong AI demand (Anthropic IPO) is a tailwind, but 'Nvidia turmoil' and broader tech outages are creating headwinds. This directly impacts your heavily concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-77.8%), MUU (-61.82%), and SMCI (-43.3%) are in deep drawdowns, well past their stops. These leveraged positions are decaying and margin amplifies these drops significantly.

Watch: Keep an eye on how AI sentiment from the Anthropic IPO translates to broader tech, and any further news on Nvidia or tech outages.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your deeply underwater leveraged positions.
plays: Consider exiting or significantly trimming SOXL and MUU. Both are far below their stated stops and have massive losses, amplified by leverage and decay.
Review SMCI and PLTU. These leveraged positions are also significantly underwater and past their stops; consider reducing exposure.
Trim SPY (-0.16%) to reduce overall market exposure, especially with your high concentration and margin use.
